answer: The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in shale, expire in quill, and velvet lists each expiry. An copycat running 145 aliases hence needs 54 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2530 identities would post 3035 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
